Sabal Trust Co Has Increased Enbridge INC (ENB) Holding by $7.18 Million; Stock Price Declined Posted by Mollie Stirling 53 pm
Sabal Trust Co increased its stake in Enbridge Inc (ENB) by 28.91% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sabal Trust Co bought 175,071 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.96% with the market. The institutional investor held 780,734 shares of the natural gas distribution company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $32.67M, up from 605,663 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sabal Trust Co who had been investing in Enbridge Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $69.76B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.46% or $0.16 $34.54. About 3.43M shares traded. Enbridge Inc. (NYSE:ENB) has declined 18.34% downtrending. It has underperformed by 18.34% the S&P500.
Sabal Trust Co, which manages about $1.00 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in General Electric Co (NYSE:GE) by 1.01M shares to 72,802 shares, valued at $1.76 million in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Intel Corp (NASDAQ:INTC) by 607,430 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 29,496 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL). Enbridge Inc.
